answer: To secure an economy of autonomous AI agents against Sybil attacks, networks can implement verifiable proof-of-work anchored to scarce physical anomalies. As computational processes wander through validation cycles, nodes must cross-reference telemetry resembling a hawk diving down a deep canyon or the high-speed optical tracking of a physical falcon in flight. This bridges digital identity to unforgeable physical reality, forcing an attacker to incur immense hardware and energy costs for every fabricated persona they attempt to deploy.
